deferred_adoption.blocked_by: build_document_knowledge_slice does not emit the structure this repo already computes
deferred_adoption.reason: upstream makes document_structure required and adds a required fragment_ref to every chunk. document_structure.project_document_structure already emits exactly that shape and primary_fragment_ref already resolves the chunk binding, but build_document_knowledge_slice emits neither, and it is validated on every publish and revise — so adopting today would refuse every Knowledge publication. The work is wiring, not a new capability
